senses.gloss: m. (v. preced.) one having an abnormally long membrum (one of the blemishes unfitting for priestly service).
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:12">Bekh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>הג׳ זה בעל קיק</he> (for Mish. <he>בעל גבר</he>).
Ib. בעל קיק בביצים ג׳ בגיד Ar. baal kik refers to the testicles, g’rabtan to the membrum (ed. קיין … גרבתא וכ׳, v. preced.).
